## Objective
This is to compute a set of features per included si mucosa fragments - which will be used for clustering


```{r}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

reviewed_mucosa <- read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_papers/spatial_lc_clustering/input/included_mucosa_reviewed.xlsx") %>%
  filter(classification != "inadequate") %>%
  mutate(excluded = case_when(exclusion_reason == "inadequate_orientation" |
                                exclusion_reason == "pancreas" |
                                exclusion_reason == "si_and_stomach" |
                                exclusion_reason == "lnn" |
                                exclusion_reason == "lesion" |
                                exclusion_reason == "fp_crypts_and_villi_in_submucosa" |
                                exclusion_reason == "fn" ~ TRUE,
                              TRUE ~ FALSE))

exclude <- reviewed_mucosa %>% select(name, excluded) %>%
  filter(excluded)

origin_folder <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/artefact/output/artefact/"
destination_folder <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_papers/spatial_lc_clustering/output/included_mucosa/"

included_mucosa_list <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_models/artefact/output/artefact/template_artefacts.json") %>%
  rename(artefact_class = classification) %>%
  filter(artefact_class == "adequate" | artefact_class == "marginal") %>%
  distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(file_name = paste0(name, "_si_artefact.geojson")) %>%
  filter(!(name %in% exclude$name))



file_names <- included_mucosa_list$file_name

#copy_selected_files(origin_folder, destination_folder, file_names) #borrowed function from select_subset

grading_template <- included_mucosa_list %>% 
  select(image_name, fragment_name, mucosa_name, name)

write_xlsx(grading_template, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Projects/fe_si_papers/spatial_lc_clustering/output/included_mucosa/grading_template_pilot.xlsx")

```
